verdict.rationale: Loops documents a POST /events/send endpoint to trigger workflows and states that sending events starts published workflows built around product events, which is the core of this story. Contacts are addressed by email or userId elsewhere in the API, which implies per-person targeting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the event payload identifies the specific contact (email/userId) whose workflow is triggered, independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automations.
